summary: This program stores a name in a variable and prints a greeting that includes it. It is the version without user input, so the name is fixed in the code.

lines.text: A String variable holds a sequence of text characters, written between double quotes. Naming the value gives you one place to change it later.

The + operator joins two pieces of text into one, so the greeting and the stored name print as a single line. Note the space at the end of "Welcome " 
u2014 without it the output would read "WelcomeAda".
